# Nutrition Plan for Powerlifting (8-week competition prep)

## Daily Calorie Target
**~3,100-3,300 calories/day** (slight surplus for muscle gain)
- BMR (~1,850) + training (~600-800) + activity factor

## Macronutrient Breakdown

| Macro | Daily Target | Purpose |
|-------|--------------|---------|
| **Protein** | 160-180g (2g/kg) | Muscle repair & recovery |
| **Carbs** | 380-420g (4.6-5.1g/kg) | Fuel for heavy training |
| **Fat** | 85-105g (1g-1.3g/kg) | Hormone production |

## Meal Structure (Sample Day)

**Breakfast:** Oats + eggs + banana + peanut butter
**Lunch:** Chicken/beef + rice + vegetables + olive oil
**Pre-workout:** Rice cakes + honey or banana
**Post-workout:** Protein shake + fast carbs (dextrose/juice)
**Dinner:** Fish/red meat + sweet potato + broccoli
**Snack:** Greek yogurt or casein shake

## Key Priorities

✓ **Eat enough** - calories matter most for strength gains
✓ **Protein timing** - 30-40g with each main meal
✓ **Post-workout nutrition** - carbs + protein within 1-2 hours
✓ **Micronutrients** - iron, zinc, magnesium (red meat, nuts, leafy greens)
✓ **Hydration** - 3-4L water daily minimum

**Consider:** Sleep 7-9 hours, manage stress, track intake for 2 weeks to dial in numbers.
